name: Pending Status 4 Code
definition: Indicates that the state of a payment at the clearing agent side is pending.

ACPD.name: Accepted
ACPD.definition: Transaction has been accepted by the clearing agent.

VALD.name: Validated
VALD.definition: Transaction has been validated by the clearing agent.

MATD.name: Matched
MATD.definition: Transaction has been matched with a corresponding transaction by the clearing agent.

AUTD.name: Authorised
AUTD.definition: Transaction has been authorised by the transaction administrator or authorised party.

UMAC.name: Unmatched
UMAC.definition: Clearing agent attempted to match the transaction with a corresponding transaction but failed.

STLE.name: Settlement Eligible
STLE.definition: Transaction is eligible for future settlement.

STLM.name: Settlement Mature
STLM.definition: Transaction is eligible for immediate settlement.

SSPD.name: Suspended
SSPD.definition: Transaction has been suspended by the clearing agent.

PCAN.name: Pending Cancellation
PCAN.definition: Clearing agent has received a cancellation request for the transaction, and needs either a matching request for cancellation from the counterparty or a confirmation from an authorised party.

PSTL.name: Pending Settlement
PSTL.definition: Transaction is eligible for settlement, but is pending.

PFST.name: Pending Failing Settlement
PFST.definition: Transaction eligible for immediate settlement, has failed to settle.

SMLR.name: Sender Multilateral Limit Related
SMLR.definition: Transaction causes the 'Sender multilateral limit' to be exceeded and cannot currently be processed.

RMLR.name: Receiver Multilateral Limit Related
RMLR.definition: Transaction causes the 'Receiver multilateral limit' to be exceeded and cannot currently be processed.

SRBL.name: Sender Receiver Bilateral Limit Related
SRBL.definition: Transaction causes the bilateral limit fixed between Sender and Receiver to be exceeded and cannot currently be processed.

AVLB.name: Held For Service Availability
AVLB.definition: Specifies that the message is queued to the receiving payment system and is awaiting processing because the receiving payment system is not operational (open) at that point in time.

SRML.name: Sender Receiver Multilateral Limit Related
SRML.definition: Transaction causes the multilateral limits fixed between Sender and Receiver to be exceeded by the total amount of submitted payments at the end of the day and cannot currently be processed.
